run_job_scheduling_baselines: run job scheduling baseline algorithms on a JSON input file with argparse CLI
run_SJF_scheduling: run the shortest job first scheduling algorithm on a job sequence from JSON data
run_EJF_scheduling: run the earliest job first scheduling algorithm on a job sequence from JSON data
run_random_scheduling: run the random scheduling algorithm on a job sequence from JSON data
run_offline_scheduling: run the offline scheduling algorithm with full job visibility on a job sequence
